data.title: bn-1gtb: rebase product test overlay after bn-2304 engine change
data.description: Uniform +16 shift of 17 patch hunk coordinates, 17 ALLOWED_RELEASE_LINE_REPLACEMENTS ordinals, the move_tail_hunk_first tail header, and the inapplicable_context mutation; ENGINE_SHA256 updated to fe559d6a. Justification: bn-2304 added exactly 16 lines to engine.rs entirely before line 1347, and every hunk/ordinal is at >=1347 and is a same-size replacement, so the shift is uniform with no cumulative drift (verified TestOwnerCohortGuard 1348->1364, file 4804->4820). Validator PASS 11 checks, SELF_TEST_PASS 17 mutations, git apply --check clean.
